entities.summary: Luis Ángel Arango Library  is a public library located in Bogotá, Colombia. It is one of the largest and most important libraries in the world. It was founded in 1958 as a small library with a few books on economics, currently its collection has about 2.000.000 works. Today the library has been expanded and occupies two entire city blocks spanning about 45,000 m2. Its collection has grown to become the country's premier library and has come to be considered the most important public library in Latin America, and one of the most visited in the world.
